name: card-hover-effect
title: Card Hover Effect
description: A three-by-two grid of near-black cards, each with a short title, a few lines of grey copy and a link. Pointing at a card slides a rounded grey backing in behind it.
use: Linking out to partners, projects or services where each needs a title and a line of copy.
avoid: You want a coloured glow: the hover adds only a flat grey backing block.
a11y: The hover ring only appears for mouse users; there is no focus-visible style for keyboard focus. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A three-by-two grid of near-black rounded cards on a black stage, each holding a short bold title and a few lines of small grey text. Wide dark gaps separate the cards, which look flat until hovered.
behaves: Pointing at a card fades a soft slate-grey rounded block in behind it, leaving a wider ring around the card edge while the others stay flat. Moving away fades the backing out.
customise: Pass an items array of title, description and link; grid columns are set in classes and the hover backing colour is in the source.
weight: light: Six links sharing one opacity animation; nothing runs when not hovered.
demo: Six company cards: Stripe, Netflix, Google, Meta, Amazon and Microsoft, each with a one-line description.
issues: The hover treatment is a flat grey block, not the glowing border the catalogue claims.
No focus styling, so keyboard users get no matching highlight.
Cards have no visible affordance that they are links until hovered.
polishWhy: Clean spacing and a readable dark grid; the hover effect is just a plain grey block.
